description: BacktestBench (KDD 2026): ~18k QA pairs over A-share daily bars 2020-2025 enforcing no-lookahead / T-1 signal discipline. QA record fields: uuid, strategy, strategy_type (metrics_calculation / ticker_selection / parameter_confirmation / strategy_selection), SQL_statement, KPI, code (reference solution), answer, factors. Record counts verified locally: test=3836, train=10215, validation=4195, total=18246.

source.paper: BacktestBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Automated Quantitative Strategy Backtesting, KDD 2026, arXiv:2605.17937, doi:10.1145/3770855.3817460
source.storage_note: dataset files are Git-LFS objects served from media.githubusercontent.com; sizes verified against the GitHub contents API at pin time
source.license_note: upstream research artifact; cached ONLY under gitignored .venv-eval/data/backtestbench/, dataset bytes are never committed

subset_rule.policy: Full 18k QA pairs are cost-prohibitive under the parity cost cap (300 USD/run); runs use a seeded subset of the test split (the benchmark evaluation split). The subset is drawn once per run and is identical for both harnesses and across all parity seeds for a given sampling seed; the run seed varies harness behavior, not task selection. The rule text is mirrored into every run report via the total_cost note.
subset_rule.sampler: sample_subset(uuids, n, seed) in adapters/backtestbench_tasks.py: pool = sorted(set(uuids)); random.Random(f'backtestbench-v1:{seed}').sample(pool, min(n, len(pool))). String-seeded random.Random is stable across processes (independent of PYTHONHASHSEED); lexicographic pre-sort makes the rule independent of file order.

fetch_policy.resume: partial downloads kept as <dest>.part and resumed via HTTP Range; a server ignoring Range restarts the file
fetch_policy.verification: exact size_bytes then sha256 BEFORE rename into place; any mismatch refuses the file with a structured error naming the reason and deletes the offending bytes; cached files are re-verified on every run (idempotent)
fetch_policy.observed_throughput_note: media.githubusercontent.com served ~20-80 KB/s from this host on 2026-08-23; the 5 QA files (~77 MB) completed in ~24 min; the 250 MB stock_tables.zip exceeds the bounded download budget and stays sha256=null until a Stage-2 fetch

files.oversized_note: 250 MB market-data dump (PostgreSQL ingestion for the benchmark's own SQL pipeline) exceeds the bounded-download budget at observed throughput; sha256 intentionally null so fetch_backtestbench.py refuses it with reason=sha256_unknown rather than installing unverified bytes. Stage 2: fetch out-of-band or with a larger budget, record its sha256 here, then ingest per tables/import_tables.ipynb. The todo-6 adapter maps QA pairs onto this repo's own loaders/backtest toolchain, so the zip is NOT required for the mock or Stage-1 opencode path.
